Digital artist nohygiene creates surreal 3D characters that combine angelic imagery, early-internet aesthetics and intensely emotional scenes. Her recurring figures have oversized heads, metallic or pale bodies, long hair and wings. They appear alone, exhausted, in love or overwhelmed, while simple symbols such (Artvangarde)as hearts, fire and tears make their emotions immediately visible. The deliberately imperfect graphics recall early 3D animation, online avatars and old computer imagery, rather than the polished realism of contemporary CGI. Across her work, these strange digital beings (Artvangarde)become vessels for very human feelings love, loneliness, anxiety, desire and emotional vulnerability. #art #loveyou #artist #niche #heart

How I turn my doodles into $$ What I’m doing is drawing my designs and then putting them onto print on demand products and digital products to sell!  Step 1: draw your designs! I am drawing on procreate and I’m pretty new to this so be nice!!  Step 2: I upload my drawing or doodle into Kittl to further edit or perfect it! Step 3: I upload the finished design onto a product on @printify  I used the create pattern tool and layered a gingham background underneath the bears! Step 4: publish your finished product on a website for sale!  You can publish to Etsy, Shopify, TikTokShop, Amazon, and more! Step 5: start bringing in orders!  How does this work? Printify is a print on demand service that you can use to sell your designs on products. They will print, pack, and ship everything for you as it is sold  You can choose from thousands of products in their catalog, upload your designs, and list for sale on your store! Because Printify can sync directly with your online store, when someone orders a product, Printify automatically gets the order and the customers info! This way they can print the design on the product, pack it up, and ship it directly to your customer!  Meaning you have a fully functional online store without any inventory or shipping yourself💅🏼💕💸✨💫🎨🩷 Full videos on my YouTube channel if you want to learn how to do this step by step! ¿Qué es el arte digital? 🌐      Cuando hablamos de arte digital la tecnología no tiene que ser el único medio de creación, con el simple hecho de que haya una intervención tecnológica, o algún elemento añadido con el ordenador, la pieza es considerada digital. Esta forma de arte puede ser generada totalmente por una computadora, escaneada, dibujada o editada utilizando un mouse o una tableta.        El arte es, pues, ante todo, experiencia. Sensaciones como resultado de pensamientos compartidos, que juntos conforman experiencias. Ciencia, tecnología y arte confluyen en la experiencia artística.      ¿Qué te parece este concepto?       #arte #artecontemporáneo #artedigital #comunicacióndigital #digitalización #museodigital #arteentiktok #pintura #videoedit #cccreator #viral #fyp #tutorial #vlog #aprendeentiktok #tiktokdesign #tiktokart #artistiktok #artisttiktok #tiktokartist
